ModMetadata.Name: Better Hydroponics [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: vinus
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Better Hydroponics[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Adds more readable logic values to hydroponics devices.
Due to limited amount of slot logic variables, there arent many well named varibles, so i had to just use whatever wasnt used already.
Using `ls [r?] [d?] slotIndex logicSlotType [i][d?] should be a Automated Hydroponics, Hydroponics Device, or a Hydroponics Station[/i]
[b]Temperature[/b]: reads the temperature efficency of plant. [b]Pressure[/b]: reads pressure efficency of plant. [b]PressureAir[/b]: reads breathing efficency of plant. [b]Volume[/b]: reads hydration efficency of plant. [b]Charge[/b]: reads light efficency of plant. [b]On[/b]: reads age of plant. [b]Lock[/b]: reads light stress of plant. [b]Open[/b]: reads lit time ratio of plant. [b]Mode[/b]: reads dark time ratio of plant.
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/
